title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 8, part 3: Grover Cleveland, First Term
summary: "A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 8, part 3" is a historical collection compiled by James D. Richardson and published between 1897-1911. This volume presents the official proclamations, messages, and speeches of President Grover Cleveland during his first term from March 1885 to March 1889. Part of an eleven-volume series spanning American presidential history from 1787 to 1902, it preserves the authentic voice of executive leadership during a pivotal period.
